Talencia is currently looking for a Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist for one of their important clients, leader on the market. You will join a highly skilled and innovative team where collaboration, expertise, and growth are part of the culture.

Your role

• Investigate and respond to advanced security incidents: malware analysis, IoC extraction, forensic investigations, breach analysis
• Manage and resolve client requests while coordinating incident, change, and use-case tickets
• Take ownership of end-to-end response activities; from detection and analysis to reporting and recommendations
• Support customers with readiness assessments, audits, and tailored consultancy
• Contribute to the wider cybersecurity community and share knowledge at industry events
• Dedicate time each month to self-learning and technical exploration
• 
Ensure strict compliance with data protection, security frameworks, and best practices

 

What you bring

• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably in incident response
• Strong analytical, forensic, and problem-solving skills
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Organized, detail-oriented, with strong reporting and documentation habits
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor junior colleagues
• Passion for continuous learning in a fast-evolving field

Do you enjoy working with machines and have a technical, hands-on mindset? Are you detail-oriented and do you like to roll up your sleeves and get to work? Then this position as a die-cutter/machine setter in Sint-Amands might be right for you.
 

As a machine setter, you’ll be responsible for die-cutting boxes. You’ll set up the die-cutting machine, monitor the production process, and perform quality checks. In addition, you’ll carry out precision mechanical tasks and ensure that the finished products are properly stacked, sorted, or packaged.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You’ll be responsible for setting up and monitoring the production process using the die-cutting machine. 

• You check the quality of the pieces. 

• You stack, sort, or package the finished product. 

• Additionally, you perform various precision mechanical tasks. 

• You ensure that operations run smoothly. 
 

• You speak and understand English well. 

• You have technical insight and/or have completed a technical education. 

• You are capable of performing physically demanding work. 

• You want to work in a production environment.

Join Logent in Evergem as a reach truck driver in a 2-shift system or a fixed night shift earning €16,37 per hour, great shift extras and €10 meal vouchers.

Looking for a stable warehouse role where your precision on the reach truck makes an immediate impact? At Logent, every workday brings clear processes, a supportive team culture, and excellent working conditions. As a reach truck driver, you keep our logistics supply chain moving smoothly and safely every single day.

Looking for a long term experience? Apply today via talentcenter40@randstad.be or 09 218 79 35.

Our AI agent Rani will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions to check whether you meet the minimum requirements for the job. Our consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have any questions about this screening, please contact us.

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for for this vacancy?

• You are an experienced reach truck driver holding an up-to-date driver certificate.
• You communicate fluently in English to ensure safe operations and smooth teamwork.
• You have your own reliable transport to reach our Evergem facilities on schedule.
• You are comfortable working in a 2-shift or fixed night system and fit within our collective leave schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas period).
Your responsibilities as a reach truck driver: 

• Operating reach trucks safely to stack, store, and transfer goods in high-bay racks.
• Loading and unloading freight trucks carefully while maintaining damage-free handling.
• Inspecting incoming shipments for quality and raising reports with your supervisor when needed.
• Staging inventory for order picking teams to prevent operational bottlenecks.
• Maintaining order, cleanliness, and safety standards across your workspace.

• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.

In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving. 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.

• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.

• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.

• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.

• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.

Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.

• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.

• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.

• Solution Development

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.

• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.

Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.

• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.

• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.

 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams

• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.

• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.

• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.

• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.

• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.

• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.

• Is fluent in English; knowloedge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

From Security Engineer to CISO, build your expertise today, lead tomorrow.
 

Our partner is a Belgian organisation with a strong and evolving IT environment, wherecybersecurity is becoming increasingly strategic.

They are looking for a Security Engineer to strengthen their security team and take an active role in securing the organisation's infrastructure, systems and cloud environment.

But this role goes beyond the technical scope.The long-term vision is to develop the right person towards a future CISO position, giving you increasing exposure to security strategy, risk, stakeholders and decision-making as you grow.
Security Engineer - Your Role
• Protect and improve the organisation'sIT infrastructure and security environment, covering networks, systems and cloud platforms.
• Manage and optimisesecurity solutionssuch as firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection and access controls.
• Investigatesecurity incidents and vulnerabilities, helping identify the root cause and implement effective solutions.
• Take part incybersecurity projects, from infrastructure hardening to cloud security and new security technologies.
• Work closely withInfrastructure, Network and IT teamsto identify risks and strengthen the overall security posture.
• Gradually take on more responsibility aroundsecurity governance, risk and strategy, preparing you for a future leadership role.
Security Engineer - Your Profile
• 3+ years of experiencein Security Engineering, Cybersecurity, Network Security or a similar technical environment.
• Strong understanding ofnetwork and infrastructure security, including firewalls, VPNs, authentication and access management.
• Experience withAzure and/or GCPor another cloud environment.
• A hands-on mindset combined with a genuine interest insecurity strategy and risk management.
• Strong communication skills and the ambition to progressively move fromtechnical expertise towards security leadership.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good understanding of the other language; English is also required.
